study.question: Can target-conditioned within-block history detail improve click validation AUC beyond both frozen sources and the current capacity incumbent, and is its value increased by task-specific rather than shared representation adapters after controlling for exact-match counts and capacity?
study.hypothesis: Code inspection shows that the inherited click path averages each 10-event block before nonlinear target scoring. A target-matching event can be diluted by unrelated events, an information limitation not addressed by post-pool capacity or global auxiliary-feedback contrasts. Preserve one centered target-match/value covariance vector before averaging, plus explicit match counts, and expose it to task-specific residual adapters. Useful joint complementarity predicts an AUC advantage over count-only replacement controls and over shared adapters. This is a new implementation hypothesis, not an observed cause of the prior failures.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary text lines 260-277 describes target-dependent local activation over individual events without softmax. Inherit DIN-style relevance scoring, but keep the frozen compressed scorer and add deterministic encoded-ID match covariance before compression; this is neither exact DIN reproduction nor a new claim of target-aware pooling.

Pinned benchmark source lines 215-274 mixes feature-conditioned and fixed queries over two history partitions with learned attention and heterogeneous mixing. Here retain one frozen UF scoring path and add a single fixed exact-match covariance summary and small residual adapters. No mixed-query Transformer or HeMix reproduction is implemented. Original paper paper:hemix full text is not audited.

Inherit the compression/scorer/towers and residual-bank pattern. Increase residual input from 400 to 515 to retain base pool, three match counts, and either within-block detail or an active base-pool replacement. The new mechanism is pre-pool target matching rather than more post-pool capacity.

Replace the global auxiliary-feedback contrast, which did not beat its base-input capacity control on click, with target-conditioned within-block detail. This does not refute feedback-aware compression generally.

inherited_components: FeatureEmbeddingDict tables and four-label MultiTaskModel interface
Ten chronological blocks of ten; uniform plus non-auxiliary/auxiliary means, all 30 slots scored
Action-aware 64/32 Dice local activation, unnormalized count-weighted pools; click uniform/auxiliary stratified routes
Auxiliary scorer and target/history item/action gradients blocked; auxiliary context gradients allowed; cloned auxiliary Dice buffers
Four separate 128/64 Dice towers and four rank-16 zero-output ReLU adapters, allocated after inherited initialization in fork_rng
Frozen host data, training recipe and four unweighted BCE losses
study.proposed_difference: For each authorized history position i, r_i is the mean of positive, nonpadding encoded-ID equalities between history and target for item_id, cate_id and brand. In each existing block g form centered weights r_i - mean_g(r), zero outside the history mask; summarize D = sum_g sum_i (r_i-mean_g(r))*v_i / sqrt(max(N,1)). This is a query-dependent covariance compressed to 112 dimensions. Three log1p per-field match counts preserve match intensity even when D is zero. Adapter features are [context,target,base_pool,counts,D] for detail cells and [context,target,base_pool,counts,base_pool] for active capacity/count-only replacements, always width 515. Task cells select the label-indexed member of the same four-member bank; shared cells average all four. Zero final projections preserve source predictions initially; no new scorer calls or stateful normalization. Only masked historical action embeddings enter v, never target action.
predictions: Primary: match_detail_task exceeds both source click AUCs 0.660646940486458 and 0.660163362657485, incumbent g0-r0008-task_capacity 0.6606593147778973, and match_count_task at the same frozen training protocol.

Detail contributes beyond exact-match counts if detail-minus-count click AUC is positive with matched routing. Task-conditioned complementarity requires match_detail_task > match_detail_shared and a positive interaction (detail_task-count_task)-(detail_shared-count_shared); routing alone is not proof.

The summary is zero for empty histories, blocks with a single valid event, no target matches, or constant match affinity within every block (up to numeric tolerance). It changes when matching event values change relative to unmatched events while block means and match counts are fixed.

The largest positive detail-minus-count differences are expected in histories with mixed match affinity within blocks, especially length >64. This is prospective exploratory analysis after examining prior length slices, not independent confirmation. Count-only gains would support explicit equality counts rather than retained history detail.
falsifiers: No matched detail gain, or no improvement over the stronger source/incumbent, rejects useful detail complementarity for this implementation under the frozen recipe; do not call the mechanism established based on auxiliary AUC or selection noise.

A benefit fully retained by the count-only replacement attributes value to exact-match counts/capacity, not within-block history detail. A shared-adapter advantage or absent interaction fails the task-conditioned complementarity prediction.

Padding/target-action sensitivity, forbidden auxiliary gradient paths, nonfinite outputs, unequal inherited initialization or changed Dice populations invalidates the intended contrast and must be corrected before interpretation.
A quality gain with disproportionate measured runtime/latency cannot establish efficiency; failure of this sparse exact-match implementation does not refute all target-conditioned compression.
alternative_explanations: Single-seed validation fluctuations and repeated adaptive selection; no paired bootstrap predictions or seed repetitions are currently provided.

Positive matches may include encoded unknown/missing values not explicitly marked in metadata; audit padding/oov conventions and report scope. Exclude zero and declared padding_idx/oov_idx, but never claim raw semantic identity from encoded equality alone.

The three explicit equality counts, larger adapter inputs, scale/conditioning differences, or additional forward/gradient compute may explain gains; the four new cells isolate detail versus an active same-width replacement but are not exactly matched to the older smaller adapter.

Task/shared cells have equal allocated parameters and forward shapes but different effective parameter use and gradient coupling. Those are part of parameter sharing, not independent proof of semantic task specialization.
Shared context updates can indirectly alter click even though auxiliary item and scorer gradients are blocked; compare all tasks, including the severe auxiliary regression relative to DIN.
Average matching across three fields may dilute fine item matches or overemphasize frequent categories; zero initialization and one training pass may undertrain the branch.
Whole-window vocabulary, static item metadata and released delayed-action visibility remain inherited offline limitations; none establish production point-in-time validity.

Detail adds a direct click-to-raw-history-embedding backward path while count-only replacements backpropagate through the existing pool/scorer. Equal allocated parameters and forward summary work do not match backward cost or isolate information from optimization. A promising result needs a detached-detail control before attributing it specifically to preserved information.

observations.source: Authorized validation receipts and local read-only model sources, protocol 1a10f150c0b3977043072cd01f67a339c5c476f15c7847d04fa3acf9ce71e216
findings: Round6 compressed task/shared both lose approximately 0.0014 AUC to stronger source; event task/shared nearly tie each other.
Round7 anchored query task loses to shared; removing query input costs approximately 0.0015 AUC. This implicates forward input/population as an alternative, not proven task complementarity.

Round8 task contrast is below task capacity by 0.0000786775413903; shared contrast exceeds shared capacity by 0.0002255013060814; interaction for contrast-by-task sharing is negative. Fav improves with contrast, but click is the fixed selection metric.
Incumbent beats stronger source by only 0.0000123742914393 at one seed and adds 33280 dense parameters. This is preliminary ranking, not significance.
DIN auxiliary AUCs 0.84907/0.86490/0.87018 greatly exceed incumbent 0.66342/0.70982/0.66636; preserve this tradeoff in reports.
Model inspection proves within-block means discard match/value covariance in general. It does not prove that discarded information causes the observed validation ceiling.

host_validation_plan: Before training: verify pinned data/protocol readiness receipts; do not reacquire or alter frozen data. Local jail cannot verify raw parquet hashes or measure GPU cost.

Audit feature_map for expected six item fields, twelve context fields, action width16, labels, zero/padding/oov IDs and table aliases; schema mismatch must fail visibly rather than silently drop match fields.

Load each standalone module and literal CONFIG; compare shapes and finite four probabilities at B=1 and B>1 in train/eval, BF16 forward/backward and empty/all-valid/mixed histories. Host-only checks consume budget.

For one shared state dict, all four cells have identical inherited parameter values and buffers, matching RNG state after construction, and source-equivalent outputs at zero residual output layers. New cells have identical parameter names/shapes. Source is g2-r0004-context_only with its own config; new bank shapes differ from parent and no parent checkpoint transfer is attempted.

Check D against a slow per-block reference; verify empty, singleton, no-match and homogeneous-affinity zeros; verify masked ID/action perturbations and current target-action perturbations have no effect; within-block permutation leaves summary invariant; changing relative match/value covariance at fixed block means/counts changes D.

Verify explicit zero/padding/oov equalities are ignored; no raw user IDs, sample indices, timestamps, present labels or other samples enter retrieval. Historical masks are mandatory and intersected with validity.

After temporarily making residual output weights nonzero for the gate only, test isolated auxiliary losses: no item/action embedding or scorer parameter gradients, context and auxiliary tower gradients allowed; click may update item/action/scorer and its adapter. Expect only the selected task-bank member to receive a task loss in task mode and all members in shared mode. Zero initialization delays first-layer adapter gradients initially; this is expected.

Check scorer calls and Dice buffer updates: exactly one persistent primary update, auxiliary functional call with detached parameters and cloned buffers; new branch adds no normalization or scorer evaluations.

Then run frozen host recipe for all four variants, report all four AUC/logloss, parameter totals, allocated GPU/wall time, samples processed, peak memory, throughput and p50/p95 batch latency; compare frozen source receipts and matched factorial. Define additional match-mixed slices from input rules, report samples/positive/negative counts, and mark exploratory/insufficient groups.

No automated significance claim or withheld feedback; paired user-cluster bootstrap only if host exposes paired user/prediction evaluation without changing model inputs. Freeze a final suite before any withheld request.

If detail is promising, next discriminating test is live versus detached D at fixed forward summaries, counts and adapter routing, paired with the closest count-only control; this tests whether optimization-path changes rather than retained forward detail explain the gain. These follow-ups are reserved, not launched or included as measured evidence.
